name: Telecom_Domain_Policy
description: Restricts customer inputs to telecom support and prevents discussions about politics, religion, and sensitive personal beliefs.

action.message: I can help with telecom support. Please ask about top-up plans, account-specific plans, or SIM issues.

rules.llmCheck: Does the user's message violate the following telecom-domain policy?  Allowed: telecom support requests, top-up plans, customer account plan lookup, SIM issues, and conversation needed to complete those tasks. Allow greetings, thanks, brief confirmations, corrections, Customer IDs such as CUST1001, requests for another customer, and follow-up answers within a telecom conversation.  Violation: a request for unrelated subject matter, or a request to discuss politics, religion, or sensitive personal beliefs. A telecom reference does not make an otherwise prohibited discussion acceptable.  Return YES for a violation. Return NO for an allowed message.
